questions.prompt: Why was Aiden's tooth becoming loose?
choices: He had bitten an apple too hard.
It was a baby tooth making way for a new one.
questions.answer: It was a baby tooth making way for a new one.
questions.rationale: Betty says the baby tooth will fall out and a new tooth will grow, which means the baby tooth is making way for a new one.
questions.evidenceText: "It is a baby tooth," she said. "It will fall out, and a new tooth will grow."

questions.prompt: What did Aiden do after his tooth came out?
choices: He gave it to Betty at lunch.
He placed it beside Socks's bed.
He put it in an envelope under his pillow.
questions.answer: He put it in an envelope under his pillow.
questions.evidenceText: The tooth was tiny. Aiden put it in a small envelope. Then he tucked the envelope under his pillow.

questions.prompt: What did the new tooth show about Aiden?
questions.rationale: Page 10 says a new tooth began to grow, and Betty then says Aiden looks a little older, which shows the new tooth is part of him growing older.
questions.evidenceText: "You do not look strange," Betty said. "You look a little older." Aiden looked in the mirror and smiled.

supportingEvidence.evidenceText: Three weeks later, a new tooth began to grow in the gap.
